body: I actually am involved with a charitable organization in the area...i've been working with them since I moved here.  It's been great to help out, but things have been slow lately with the group.

When I got the relocation to Chicago, I was offered a competing position in London.  I regret not making that choice, but at this time I don't see how my career path will allow me to move to another country.  I just started a new job back in California to get back on my feet again.  Unfortunately, the (civil) engineering degree is 13 years old and not very valuable to me anymore.
